_doc: The INSTALL ontology's declared `data_from_field` users, measured 2026-08-02. DATA, not a fixture the engine reads: it lives here so the gate can pin what an installation declares WITHOUT the test source naming install tipos (the census counts a tipo token in a *.test.ts as a binding; test/**/fixtures/ is data and excluded). Absence is NOT a failure — a database carrying a different installation is not drift — but a carrier that is PRESENT and unpinned is.
_snapshot_doc: Carriers a suite-DB SNAPSHOT holds that the live app ontology no longer does (verified absent from the app database 2026-08-02; same shape as its pinned sibling). Tolerated by the reverse census so a stale snapshot does not read as a new 5th user.
